blocks.text: Fossil has always been inspired by American creativity and ingenuity. Since 1984, we've strived to bring new life into the wrist watch industry by making quality, fashionable Fossil watches for women and accessories that were both fun and accessible.

items.label: SCRATCH-RESISTANT LENS
items.value: 38mm case, 18mm band, hardened mineral crystal lens resists scratches. A Quartz movement with multifunction analog display creates a ladies watch for style and accuracy; imported

items.label: STYLISH DESIGN
items.value: Round gold stainless steel case, with gold textured dial and glitz accents. Great for those seeking fashionable watches for women

items.label: SECURE FIT
items.value: Durable gold stainless steel bracelet with a secure fold-over clasp; links can be removed for a customized fit

items.label: WATER RESISTANT 100m
items.value: This watch for women is suitable for bathing, swimming, or snorkeling, but not scuba diving; features 10 ATM

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Stainless steel bracelet band, multifunction movement
